text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our second summer camp begins. Now unshackled by doubts, Fine Motion intends to enjoy it to the best of her ability.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Fine Motion's situation has spurred Air Shakur into striving to move forward as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Sapporo Kinen awaits midway through summer camp, and Fine Motion readies herself for it with a newfound resolve!
